overview.en:
An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works: planning, TDD, debugging, and collaboration workflows.

Use structured planning, testing, and debugging practices on an actual development task. Keep the problem and acceptance criteria concrete before implementing changes.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
通过规划、测试驱动开发、调试与协作方法完成软件开发。

在实际开发任务中应用结构化规划、测试和调试方法，实施前明确问题与验收条件。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Plan the implementation of this feature with clear acceptance criteria.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个功能规划实现步骤，并明确验收条件。

starterPrompts.en: Diagnose this failing test before changing the implementation.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 先诊断这个失败测试，再修改实现。

starterPrompts.en: Review this change and identify the verification still needed.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 审查这项变更，找出仍需完成的验证。
